Ownership transfer does not turn an old fragment observation into a new fragment observation.

common_likelihood_requirement.minimum_payload: Within the existing measurement/registry interfaces, bind each evidence contribution to its measured fragment and observation interval; retain which current cells/pixels supplied support/reliability. Preserve correlations and original sample set. No new persisted side framework.
common_likelihood_requirement.history_alternative: A change inferred through B1->B2 must use the conditioned history of B1 and the observation of B2; it must not rename B1 reliable count as B2 establishment. Discarding B1 requires an explicit sufficient summary for every remaining likelihood/action consumer.
